How seasons are rated

Every drink is scored for each season by the same engine. Great = a signature reason for that season (the season in its name, a defining ingredient like cider, eggnog, elderflower or passion fruit, or a defining style like hot drinks or tiki) and nothing fighting it. Needs a switch = clearly seasonal but one ingredient clashes; the card says what to swap. Year-round fit = works any time, no seasonal hook. Neutral = no real signal either way. Off-season = something clashes (hot or creamy in summer, tropical in winter). Garnishes and bitters never decide a tier. Hand-verified winter picks and your Yes/No decisions in Design mode always override the score.

Built from channel/site descriptions and structured recipe data where available. Winter-fit ratings and ingredient-accessibility are rule-based estimates, not a human tasting panel — treat borderline "Maybe" calls as a nudge to go look at the source.
